title: Ziyarat of Prophet Muhammad
intro: The visitation of Prophet Muhammad at his resting place in Madinah, with salutations and prayers to Allah.
description: Read Ziyarat of Prophet Muhammad with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Ziyarat of Holy Prophet (sawa) (at Rawza in Madinah)

The method of visiting the shrine of the Holy Prophet (s) is as follows:

When you arrive in the holy city of al-Madinah, you may bathe yourself, preparing yourself for the ziyarah. When you intend to enter The Holy Prophet’s Mosque, you should stop at the door of the mosque and say the FIRST form of asking permission for entering there. You may enter from the Gate of Archangel Gabriel (Bab Jibra’il) preceding the right foot to the left.

You may then Allahu Akbar repeat one hundred times.
You may then offer the two unit prayer of Greeting the Mosque (tahiyyat al-masjid). After that, you may walk to the holy chamber that includes the tomb of the Holy Prophet. There, you may touch it with your hand, kiss it, and say the following:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
I bear witness that you conveyed the Mission,
performed the prayers,
gave alms,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

blocks.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and served Almighty Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
Blessings and mercy of Allah be upon you
and upon your Household, the Immaculate.

blocks.text: You may then stand near the fore pillar on the right hand side of the tomb with the minbar to your right, facing the kiblah, and this is where the Holy Prophet’s head rests. You may then say the following:

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu
blocks.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, One and Only and having no associate,

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
blocks.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
I bear witness that you are the messenger of Allah
and you are Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka qad ballaghta risalati rabbika
blocks.english: I bear witness that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord,
offered your people good advice,
striven hard in the way of Allah,
worshipped Allah -until death came upon you-
with wisdom and fair exhortation,
fulfilled the duty that was incumbent upon you,
acted compassionately to the believers,
and been firm of heart against the unbelievers.

blocks.arabic: فَبَلَّغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ افْضَلَ شَرَفِ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: faballgha allahu bika afdala sharafi mahalli almukarramina
blocks.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones.

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنْ ٱلشِّرْكِ وَٱلضَّلالَةِ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alshshirki walddalalati
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you, from polytheism and error.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَٱجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَصَلَوَاتِ مَلائِكَتِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma faj`al salawatika wa salawati mala'ikatika almuqarrabina
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) pour Your blessings and the blessings of Your Archangels,
Your commissioned Prophets,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

blocks.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina
blocks.english: and all those who glorified You, O Lord of the Worlds,
from the past and the coming generations,
on Muhammad—Your servant, Your Messenger,
Your Prophet, Your Trustee,
Your Confidant, Your Most Beloved,
Your Choice, Your Select,

blocks.transliteration: wa safwatika wa khiyaratika min khalqika
blocks.english: Your elite, and the best of Your creation.
O Allah, (please do) confer upon him with the Elevated Rank,
grant him the right of intercession for entering Paradise,

blocks.arabic: وَٱبْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ ٱلاوَّلُونَ وَٱلآخِرُونَ
blocks.transliteration: wab`athhu maqaman mahmudan yaghbituhu bihi al-awwaluna wal-akhiruna
blocks.english: and raise him to a Position of Glory that all the past and the coming generations will wish to have.
O Allah, You have said,

blocks.arabic: «وَلَوْ انَّهُمْ إِذْ ظَلَمُوا انْفُسَهُمْ جَاؤُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوٱ ٱللَّهَ
blocks.transliteration: walaw annahum idh zalamu anfusahum ja'uka fastaghfaru allaha
blocks.english: “And had they, when they were unjust to themselves, come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

blocks.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَيْتُكَ مُسْتَغْفِراً تَائِباً مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
blocks.transliteration: wa inni ataytuka mustaghfiran ta'iban min dhunubi
blocks.english: Here I am, before you, asking Allah’s forgiveness, repenting from my sins,

blocks.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكَ لِيَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي
blocks.transliteration: wa inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbi wa rabbika liyaghfira li dhunubi
blocks.english: and seeking your intercession for me before Almighty Allah—your and my Lord—that He may forgive my sins.

blocks.text:
If you have a certain request to pray Almighty Allah for granting it, you may stand before the holy tomb and make it between your shoulders, face the direction of kiblah, raise your hands, and pray for the settlement of your need, for it is predictable that your need will be settled, Allah willing.

Ibn Qawlawayh, through a considerable chain of authority, has reported Muhammad ibn Mas`ud as saying that he, once, saw Imam Ja`far al-Sadiq (‘a) coming near the tomb of the Holy Prophet(s), putting his hand on it, and saying these words:

blocks.english: I pray Allah -Who has chosen you, selected you,
guided you, and guided (others) through you-
to bless You.

blocks.transliteration: inna allaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna `ala alnnabiyyi
blocks.english: “Surely, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet;

blocks.arabic: يَا ايُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْلِيماً.»
blocks.transliteration: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu sallu `alayhi wa sallumu tasliman
blocks.english: O you who believe! Call for (Divine) blessings on him and salute him with a (becoming) salutation.”
I beseech You, O All-magnanimous,
O All-generous,
O Nigh,
O Remote,
to renew Your boons to me.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت محمد ﷺ کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
